mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PORTFOLIO ( PORTFOLIO_NUM, USER_NUM, PORTFOLIO_TITLE, FILE_URL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{portfolioNum}, #{userNum}, #{portfolioTitle}, #{fileUrl}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PORTFOLIO_NUM AS DOCUMENT_NUM, PORTFOLIO_TITLE AS DOCUMENT_TITLE FROM T_PORTFOLIO WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC, PORTFOLIO_NUM DESC
SELECT PORTFOLIO_NUM AS DOCUMENT_NUM, PORTFOLIO_TITLE AS DOCUMENT_TITLE, CREATED_AT FROM T_PORTFOLIO WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, PORTFOLIO_NUM DESC
